text:
How many Hispanic students were enrolled in Milford School District during 2024-25 school year?
M. A. Hull
There were 1,246 Hispanic students enrolled in Milford School District during the 2024-25 school year, 0.9% more than the previous year, according to Delaware Open Data.
Data showed that the district welcomed 4,942 students during the 2024-25 school year. Among them, Hispanic students comprised 25.2% of the student body to be the third most represented ethnicity in the district.
Milford School District roughly covers schools within Sussex County and has a main office in Milford.
Among the six schools in Milford School District, Milford Senior High School recorded the highest enrollment of Hispanic students in the 2024-25 school year, with a total of 382 students.
Some schools may not publish detailed enrollment data due to privacy concerns or reporting limitations.
According to a WalletHub study, Delaware’s education system was rated the safest in the country and ranked 12th overall. However, the state posted some of the weakest results in reading and overall SAT performance.

| 2022-23 | 4,913 | 1,175 | 23.9% |
| 2023-24 | 5,059 | 1,235 | 24.4% |
